a61c002640c9e52d9573e8f37b04f633cd05d2e4.sourceText:
| 功能 | xacro | xmacro |
|---|---|---|
| 定义变量 | `<xacro:property name="r" value="0.1"/>` | `<xmacro_define_value name="r" value="0.1"/>` |
| 使用变量 | `${r}` | `${r}` |
| 数学表达式 | `${2 * r}` | `${2 * r}` |
| 定义宏 | `<xacro:macro name="wheel" params="r w">` | `<xmacro_define_block name="wheel" params="r w">` |
| 调用宏 | `<xacro:wheel r="..." w="..."/>` | `<xmacro_block name="wheel" r="..." w="..."/>` |
| include | `<xacro:include filename="xxx.xacro"/>` | `<xmacro_include uri="file://xxx.xmacro"/>` |
| 条件 | `<xacro:if value="${...}">...</xacro:if>` | 主要通过 `<xmacro_block ... condition="${...}"/>` |
| namespace | `xmlns:xacro=...` | 不需要 |
| 参数默认值等高级功能 | 较丰富 | 简化很多 |
a61c002640c9e52d9573e8f37b04f633cd05d2e4.translatedText:
| Function | xacro | xmacro |
|---|---|---|
| Define variables | `<xacro:property name="r" value="0.1"/>` | `<xmacro_define_value name="r" value="0.1"/>` |
| Use variables | `${r}` | `${r}` |
| Mathematical expressions | `${2 * r}` | `${2 * r}` |
| Define macros | `<xacro:macro name="wheel" params="r w">` | `<xmacro_define_block name="wheel" params="r w">` |
| Invoke macros | `<xacro:wheel r="..." w="..."/>` | `<xmacro_block name="wheel" r="..." w="..."/>` |
| include | `<xacro:include filename="xxx.xacro"/>` | `<xmacro_include uri="file://xxx.xmacro"/>` |
| Condition | `<xacro:if value="${...}">...</xacro:if>` | Mainly through `<xmacro_block ... condition="${...}"/>` |
| namespace | `xmlns:xacro=...` | not required |
| Advanced features such as default parameter values | Relatively rich | Much simplified |
